Small jump tables contain an unsigned byte or half, representing the offset from the lowest-addressed possible destination to the desired basic block.

detaileddescription.para: Since all instructions are 4-byte aligned, this is further compressed by counting in instructions rather than bytes (i.e. divided by 4). So, to materialize the correct destination we need: adr xDest, .LBB0_0 ldrb wScratch, [xTable, xEntry] (with "lsl #1" for ldrh). add xDest, xDest, xScratch (with "lsl #2" for smaller entries)
